facts.text: The hotel is perched high above the Bangsar district with sweeping views of the city.
facts.excerpt: Perched high above the dynamic Bangsar district, Alila Bangsar offers a calm, contemporary retreat with sweeping views of the city.

facts.text: The hotel is moments from Kuala Lumpur's culinary hotspots, cultural enclaves and main transit lines.
facts.excerpt: Just moments from Kuala Lumpur’s culinary hotspots, cultural enclaves and main transit lines

facts.text: Rooms and suites occupy the 35th to 40th floors and offer uninterrupted views of the Kuala Lumpur skyline.
facts.excerpt: Occupying the 35th to 40th floors, all our rooms and suites offer luxurious amenities and uninterrupted views of the Kuala Lumpur skyline.

facts.text: Many rooms have separate sitting areas, rainfall showers and spacious balconies.
facts.excerpt: Many boast separate sitting areas, rainfall showers, and spacious balconies.

facts.text: The Alila Suite is a one-bedroom suite with a king bed, a separate living and dining area, and a balcony.
facts.excerpt: inside this one-bedroom suite, featuring one king bed, a separate living and dining area, and a balcony.

facts.text: The Bangsar Suite is a corner suite with a king bed and a separate living area with city skyline views.
facts.excerpt: corner suite, furnished with one king bed, a separate living area with city skyline views, and a bathroom with a rainfall shower.

facts.text: The Junior Suite is a corner room with a king bed and a separate sitting area.
facts.excerpt: in this corner room, with one king bed, separate sitting area, and a bathroom with a rainfall shower.

facts.text: Entier serves French plates in a communal dining setting on the 41st floor.
facts.excerpt: Savor French plates in a serene communal dining setting on the 41st floor.

facts.text: Entier takes a nose-to-tail approach, inspired by an old French word meaning whole or entire.
facts.excerpt: Entier, an old French word meaning “whole” or “entire,” is the inspiration behind the restaurant’s nose-to-tail approach.

facts.text: Botanica + Co is an all-day ground-floor restaurant where lush plants give the feeling of a greenhouse.
facts.excerpt: Lush plants give the feeling of being in a greenhouse.

facts.text: Le Comptoir is a high-rise bar and lounge with city views, artisanal cocktails and petite plates.
facts.excerpt: An intimate, high-rise bar and lounge offering spectacular city views, artisanal cocktails, and curated petite plates.

facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Escape the bustling city and relax by our outdoor pool or cool off with a refreshing dip.

facts.text: The fitness center has cardio and strength-training equipment.
facts.excerpt: featuring the latest cardio and strength-training equipment.

facts.text: Alila Moments include a Malaysian origami session exploring traditional folds and cultural symbolism.
facts.excerpt: Discover the quiet power of paper in this mindful Malaysian origami session. Learn traditional folds, uncover cultural symbolism

facts.text: A sound bath experience uses traditional handpan and singing bowls.
facts.excerpt: Surrender to the healing resonance of traditional handpan and singing bowls in a deeply restorative sound bath.

facts.text: A Peranakan beading workshop teaches the symbolism, history and craft of the beadwork, and guests stitch their own piece.
facts.excerpt: Learn the symbolism, history and craft behind this centuries-old practice—and stitch your own piece of cultural artistry.

facts.text: A terrarium workshop lets guests build their own terrarium and take it home.
facts.excerpt: you'll build your own terrarium, layering soil, stones and handpicked plants to create a living piece of art.
